what_happened: Re-deriving the nine CI checks from the live .github/workflows/ci.yml (as the dispatch instructed) surfaced that the dispatch's own drafted check list omitted required arguments on 3 of 9 checks (check-copyright-headers.sh and readme-lint.sh both need 'FormalSystem BimodalTools', not bare; lake exe mk_all needs '--lib FormalSystem --check', not bare '--check') and that check 9 (lint-style) is actually three sub-checks bundled into one CI step outcome. Caught before planning/implementation rather than after.

Plan phase: suite_selection_select over this task's three touched paths (scripts/verify-all.sh, CONTRIBUTING.md, scripts/README.md) returned a MIXED output -- __FULL_SWEEP__ for the first two, plus 17 core agent-system suites mapped from scripts/README.md alone. The mapping appears to be a generic scripts/README.md path match in the agent-system's own suite map rather than real coverage of this Lean repo's file, so Tier Justification lines name verify-touched.sh as the command without asserting a suite list, per plan-format.md's mixed-output honesty rule. No research re-round was needed: the research report's re-derivation of ci.yml's nine invocations was byte-exact against lines 127-267 of the live file at plan-authoring time.

scripts/verify-all.sh ran end-to-end on the current tree and correctly surfaced a genuine pre-existing check-paper-definitions.sh content drift (8 PASS, 1 FAIL, 0 SKIPPED) while all later checks still executed, confirming the continue-past-failure design works without needing an artificial seed for this particular property.

A full scripts/verify-all.sh run (nine checks, including check-evidence-probes.sh and check-module-invariants.sh --no-build) exceeded 10 minutes wall time; required a bounded detached run (timeout 1500 + kill -0 liveness loop) rather than a single foreground Bash call to observe completion.

Seeding check 9's executable-bit sub-check requires a STAGED mode change (git add), not a bare working-tree chmod +x: 'git ls-files -s' (the exact command ci.yml and scripts/verify-all.sh both use) reports the git INDEX mode, which is unaffected by an unstaged filesystem permission change. Once staged, the seeded run correctly reported check 9 FAIL naming the exact file, continued through all nine checks (check 7 also genuinely failing simultaneously), and exited nonzero; reverting via git restore --staged + chmod -x returned both sub-checks to PASS, confirmed directly via the sub-check commands rather than a third ~12-minute full run.

No network access to 'gh run view' in this sandbox, so CI parity for the current commit could not be established against an observed CI run. Followed the plan's own stated contingency: parity was instead verified against .github/workflows/ci.yml's text (the nine invocations are byte-exact, re-confirmed at implementation time), and the aggregator's own clean-tree run (8 PASS, 1 pre-existing FAIL on check-paper-definitions.sh, 0 SKIPPED) is recorded as the local baseline rather than cross-checked against a live CI report.

Phase 1's verification bullet 'grep -c report  scripts/verify-all.sh equals the script's own expected value' does not hold as a static count (12 literal matches vs expected=9) because checks 8-9 are reported from two mutually-exclusive if/else branches (lake-present vs lake-absent), plus one incidental match inside the out-of-sync error message text. The real, load-bearing invariant is the RUNTIME one the script itself asserts (seen -ne expected), which was confirmed correct both via two live runs (seen=9) and via an isolated logic test that bumped expected=10 and confirmed the out-of-sync branch fires correctly. The static grep is a plan-authoring-time heuristic that does not survive the SKIPPED-branch design; the script's actual behavior is correct.

bash .claude/scripts/verify-touched.sh scripts/verify-all.sh CONTRIBUTING.md scripts/README.md (the Batch Gate Deferral's scoped-tier check) maps all three paths to its NO-SUITE-BY-CLASS fallback battery (the full .claude/scripts/tests/ meta suite), as the plan's own Phase 1 Tier Justification anticipated. That fallback battery reports 12 pre-existing failing suites, all tracing to one root cause unrelated to this task: test-sweep-invalidated-claims.sh (and 11 others) look for agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/... relative to the project root, but .claude-extensions.json's actual source_dir for the core extension is /home/benjamin/.config/nvim/agent-system/extensions/core -- an absolute path outside this repository that this sandbox does not have mounted at the relative location the tests expect. Confirmed pre-existing and independent of this task's edits: scripts/verify-all.sh, CONTRIBUTING.md, and scripts/README.md are plain project files with no relation to the .claude/ meta test harness. Real coverage for this task's own deliverable was the Tier Justification's stated fallback: bash -n scripts/verify-all.sh plus three full real runs of the script (clean, seeded-executable-bit, post-revert) and an isolated logic test of the report()/terminal-block aggregation.
